description: Danmarks Statistik: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Danmarks Statistik. Coverage: Danmarks Statistik. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Trafikarbejde med tog efter transporttype; Trafikarbejdet med danske køretøjer på danske veje efter transportmidd; Vejnet pr. 1. januar efter landsdel og vejtype; Trafikhavnenes skibsanløb, passagerer og godsomsætning efter havn og e. Formats seen: XML, CSV, HTML, XLSX, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
